summary: Big group quotes confirm without timing out
description:
At peak times the PMS takes 20+ seconds to create an availability block, so confirming a big group quote times out in the web app and the organiser sees an error although the rooms may be held.

Use the PMS's async mode: confirming requests the blocks and returns at once; the quote shows as pending until the PMS says every block exists.

Subtasks:
- HOT-541 Confirm quotes through the PMS's async mode
